title: Zerobus Ingest into default storage is now in Public Preview
body: Ingesting into tables backed by [default storage](/aws/en/storage/default-storage) with Zerobus Ingest in Lakeflow Connect is now in [Public Preview](/aws/en/release-notes/release-types). See [Create or identify the target table](/aws/en/ingestion/zerobus-ingest#create-or-identify-the-target-table).

ref_links.text: Create or identify the target table
